summary: Frontend-only regression test of new mobile hero optimizations and touch swipe theme switching on Lewis Hamilton fan archive. All 5 required scenarios PASSED: (1) Mobile 390x844 layout has zero overlap between hero-title, hero-image, and hero-statistics; swipe hint visible. (2) Horizontal touch swipes cycle themes ferrari->mercedes->mclaren (left) and back (right), with hero-image src updating to matching /images/lewis-<team>.png. (3) Mobile hotspot tap on hero-hotspot-heart opens hero-hotspot-card-heart with visible copy (154 chars) and no overlap with stats row. (4) Vertical swipe up navigates to circuit-spatial-viewport (SILVERSTONE) without changing team theme. (5) Desktop 1920x800: swipe hint display:none (hidden), Mercedes theme button switches model correctly, heart hotspot card expands on hover.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroStage.jsx: single-file component ~150 lines with inline JSX and inline styles - acceptable size, but LAYOUTS + HOTSPOT_CONTENT could move to a data module for reuse.
Touch swipe handler in HeroStage.jsx correctly requires |dx|>56 and |dx|>|dy|*1.4 which cleanly disambiguates from vertical navigation - verified via vertical swipe regression test.
Global touchmove capture handler in SpatialExperience.jsx now bails when horizontal>vertical - working correctly (theme unchanged during vertical up-swipe, circuit still navigates).
Non-blocking: three.js Clock deprecation warnings printed to console.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile tests dispatched synthetic TouchEvent via page.evaluate because Playwright context did not have hasTouch preset; this successfully triggered the hero touchstart/touchend swipe logic. If a future test needs true native touch, create a new context with hasTouch=True. Data-testids used: hero-title, hero-image, hero-statistics, hero-swipe-hint, hero-section, hero-hotspot-heart, hero-hotspot-card-heart, circuit-spatial-viewport. Team theme persists in localStorage key 'hamilton-team-theme'; clear/set before tests. THEME_ORDER=[ferrari,mercedes,mclaren].
